title: Empty SizedBox claims hits
evidence: Scenario focus_input__childless_sizedbox_passes_hits matches at HEAD a19bf487: a childless 20x20 SizedBox over a tappable underlay leaves the tap on the underlay on both sides (taps=1 on each). paints_own_hit_surface (painting.rs:101) returns true for a Box only when its alpha is above 0.
impact: None at HEAD: the claimed behaviour does not reproduce.
cause: Not reproduced; the placeholder no longer self-hits.
fix_direction: None. Keep the scenario as regression evidence.
limitations: Only the tap case over a GestureDetector underlay was compared.

title: FocusScope traverses widget order by default
evidence: Scenario divergence at frame 2 (32 ms): first_focused Flutter 1, Incular 0; last_focused Flutter 0, Incular 1. Reproduced at HEAD a19bf487.
impact: Tab moves to a different control when visual reading order differs from construction order.
cause: FocusScope::new installs FocusTraversalPolicyKind::WidgetOrder (focus_keyboard.rs:105); Flutter inherits ReadingOrder.
fix_direction: Default FocusScope to reading order; keep an explicit widget-order option.
limitations: Only the default-policy case was compared.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: PageDown does not scroll a focused list
evidence: Reproduced at HEAD a19bf487: offset diverges for 9 frames, max difference 480 px. handle_key page scroll applies only to text fields and selectable text (text_shortcuts.rs ScrollPage); a focused list row gets none.
impact: Keyboard users cannot page a focused scroll view with PageDown. Ctrl+Arrow scrolling (app.dart:1283-1292) is also absent.
cause: Flutter WidgetsApp maps PageDown and Ctrl+Arrow to ScrollIntent; Incular has no default scroll action outside text editing.
fix_direction: Add a default page-scroll action for the nearest scrollable of the focused element, using 0.8 viewport increment and 100 ms easeInOut.
limitations: Only vertical PageDown on a list was compared.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Arrow keys do not move focus directionally
evidence: Divergence at frame 2 (32 ms): after ArrowRight from a row of three, Flutter moves focus to b, Incular keeps focus on a. Later frames diverge too (c_focused at frame 3). Incular arrow keys only drive menus (menu_directional_focus_target).
impact: Arrow-key navigation between controls in a row or grid does not work in Incular.
cause: No directional focus action or geometric directional query exists in the focus policies (crates/incular-gestures/src/focus.rs).
fix_direction: Add a directional query over focus node rects and a default arrow-key binding with Flutter's semantics.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Reading order groups rows by height tolerance, not band overlap
evidence: Divergence at frame 2 (32 ms): Flutter focuses b (vertically overlapping the topmost node, left of a); Incular focuses a first because the 15 px vertical offset exceeds its 11 px row tolerance.
impact: Tab order differs for staggered layouts.
cause: Tolerance-based comparator instead of Flutter's band-overlap grouping.
fix_direction: Implement Flutter's band grouping (pick topmost, collect vertically overlapping nodes, sort by left).
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Ordered traversal ties use registration order, not reading order
evidence: Divergence at frame 3 (48 ms): Flutter visits numeric-ordered z, then unordered y (higher on screen) before x; Incular visits x (registration order) before y.
impact: Unordered controls in an ordered group are visited in construction order instead of geometric order.
cause: explicit_order keeps registration order for unordered nodes; Flutter uses ReadingOrder as the secondary policy.
fix_direction: Sort unordered and tied nodes by reading order before the stable order sort.
limitations: Only unordered nodes were compared, not equal numeric orders.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Nested MouseRegion enter callbacks fire inner first
evidence: Divergence at frame 1 (16 ms): Flutter enter order is outer then inner (sequence 12); Incular is inner then outer (21). Exit order is inner then outer on both sides and matches.
impact: Code relying on enter order across nested regions sees the reverse sequence.
cause: Enter list follows hit.raw(), which is frontmost first; Flutter reverses the hit-test order for enter events.
fix_direction: Dispatch enter callbacks in reverse hit-test order.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
